title: State v. Reyes
facts: Defendant was stopped after failing to maintain a single lane
jury_instructions: Evaluate the reliability of the breathalyzer calibration records alongside the officer's observations.

evidence_items.content: Breathalyzer reading of 0.09% blood alcohol content.
Arresting officer testified the defendant had slurred speech and bloodshot eyes.
Dashcam video of the traffic stop and field sobriety test.
Breathalyzer calibration log showing the device was serviced two days prior.
